stage0012_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$リディ$$
「So, you're the pilot of that AT?」

stage0012_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
Riddhe
「I'm Ensign $$リディ・マーセナス$$.
　I look forward to working with you.」

stage0012_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
Chirico
「$$キリコ・キュービィー$$.」

stage0012_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$リディ$$
「I saw your piloting skill in the last battle.
　How about running a simulated mock battle
　with me?」

stage0012_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$リディ$$
「I wonder... did I say something to bother him?」

stage0012_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's not your fault, Ensign.
　$$キリコ$$'s like that with everyone.」

stage0012_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$カツ$$
「Unfriendly as he is,
　he actually took $$ミスリル$$'s scouting offer.」

stage0012_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$リディ$$
「I can hardly picture him agreeing to
　$$ミスリル$$'s creed of guarding the world unseen...」

stage0012_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Even we who've fought alongside him
　don't know why $$キリコ$$ joined $$ミスリル$$.」

stage0012_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「But he's a man worth trusting.
　I think you and $$カツ$$ will see that someday.」

stage0012_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$カツ$$
「I guess that's how it is...」

stage0012_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$リディ$$
「If $$カミーユ$$ says so, I'll believe it.」

stage0012_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$カツ$$
「By the way, $$カミーユ$$...
　Do you know where Master Sergeant $$マオ$$ is?
　She promised to help with my training...」

stage0012_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$マオ$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, $$カツ$$.
　Let's get started right away.」

stage0012_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$カツ$$
「Ah, right.
　Please go easy on me.」

stage0012_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$マオ$$
「Heh... Brace yourself, $$カツ$$.
　Lieutenant $$エマ$$ asked me to do this,
　so your training's going to be brutal.」

stage0012_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$マオ$$
「Time to unleash my Marine drill again!」

stage0012_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$マオ$$
「Up! Up! Up!
　Mommy and Daddy's precious good boy!
　Pull your pants up!」

stage0012_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$マオ$$
「I'll take real good care of you!
　You won't be able to laugh or cry when I'm done!」

stage0012_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$リディ$$
「K-$$カミーユ$$... how about some tea?」

stage0012_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「R-right...
　We shouldn't interrupt their training...」

stage0012_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$マオ$$
「Thanks for the concern.
　Now... good boy, let's get started!」

stage0012_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$マオ$$
「Starting now, you rise from the lowest
　of humanity to its finest soldier!
　No, I'll make it happen myself!!」

stage0012_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$甲児$$
「...Backup for some club...
　Sure, that's right up our alley, but...」

stage0012_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$アルト$$
「The ones needing help... the rugby club, right?」

stage0012_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$アルト$$
「I'll ask again.
　You're the rugby club, not the sewing club, right?」

stage0012_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$アルト$$
「Then why are there lace curtains in the clubroom,
　and it smells like potpourri!?」

stage0012_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$アルト$$
「And what's more!?
　Why's a rugby clubroom serving up
　herbal tea!?」

stage0012_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$n
「This time, $$宗介$$'s right.
　Rare as that is.」

stage0012_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$アルト$$
「$n!
　Being around $$宗介$$ so much
　wrecked your sense of normal, didn't it!?」

stage0012_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Looks like $n went through shock, anger,
　and disbelief, and came out enlightened.」

stage0012_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$郷田$$
「Um... the rosehip tea...
　did it not suit you?」

stage0012_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$郷田$$
「I'm sorry.
　I thought you'd enjoy it, so I made it, but...」

stage0012_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$アルト$$
「Ah... no... sorry.
　It's not that I don't appreciate the thought...」

stage0012_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$郷田$$
「That's it!
　If you're feeling on edge, chamomile
　would suit you better!」

stage0012_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$石原$$
「Understood, Captain.
　I'll have it ready right away.」

stage0012_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$アルト$$
「I keep telling you!
　That's not the issue!」

stage0012_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...See for yourselves, everyone.
　This is the rugby club we're helping out.」

stage0012_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$郷田$$
「Allow me to introduce myself.
　I'm $$郷田$$, the team captain.」

stage0012_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$郷田$$
「Right now, the team's out buying
　cake for you all to enjoy.」

stage0012_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$郷田$$
「Ah, yes...
　Since it's special today, we planned a welcome tea...」

stage0012_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$アルト$$
「Forget it!
　I can't put up with people like this!」

stage0012_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Big tough guys with maiden hearts,
　and $$アルト$$, maiden looks, all fighting spirit...
　Oil and water, this is...」

stage0012_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Please calm down, $$アルト$$.
　If we don't help this rugby club,
　our volunteer club won't be approved.」

stage0012_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$郷田$$
「A volunteer club, huh? That's nice.」

stage0012_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That's right...
　This rugby club plays with local kids,
　visits lonely seniors, all that...」

stage0012_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$かなめ$$
「But the actual rugby? Hopeless, honestly.
　Over ten years with zero wins in a real match...
　of course the school has complaints...」

stage0012_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$さやか$$
「So that's why they were told to disband...」

stage0012_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$かなめ$$
「President $$林水$$ argued that
　shutting us down like that violates our
　self-governance, and kept pushing the school...」

stage0012_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$かなめ$$
「In the end, we won a certain condition.」

stage0012_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$かなめ$$
「If we win our next match against
　Garasuyama High, disbandment's on hold...
　Lose, and it's over right then.」

stage0012_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$甲児$$
「Is this Garasuyama High any good?」

stage0012_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「We've played them 49 times so far...
　Jindai's lost every single one.」

stage0012_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$アルト$$
「But if we don't win, the rugby club's done...
　and our club won't be approved either...」

stage0012_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$甲児$$
「But hey, with me, $$アルト$$, $$ミシェル$$, $$宗介$$,
　and $n joining in, we could put up a fight!」

stage0012_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ボス$$
「Why are we left out of that!?」

stage0012_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$甲児$$
「Oh, right, right.
　And with $$ボス$$, $$ヌケ$$, and $$ムチャ$$ too,
　that's eight strong arms right there.」

stage0012_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「That's the quickest way to go, yeah.
　If it comes to it, we could just call up
　$$カミーユ$$, $$朔哉$$, and $$ジョニー$$ too.」

stage0012_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「If push comes to shove, $$クラン$$ can help too.」

stage0012_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$クラン$$
「Right! I won't lose to any ordinary man!」

stage0012_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$アルト$$
「You got a problem with that?」

stage0012_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$アルト$$
「If you've got something to say, say it.
　And just so you know, we're doing this for you.」

stage0012_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$郷田$$
「...But, doing it that way,
　I think that's a little unfair...」

stage0012_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$郷田$$
「We really are a weak team...
　Tackling and being tackled both scare us,
　and every maul and scrum means fighting fear...」

stage0012_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$郷田$$
「But we love rugby!
　Win or lose!」

stage0012_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$かなめ$$
「'Win or'... you haven't won at all...」

stage0012_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$郷田$$
「That's why I... we...!
　We want to fight to the end on our own strength!」

stage0012_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$甲児$$
「You think you can beat Garasuyama without us?」

stage0012_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$アルト$$
「They said they'll do this on their own.
　It's not our place to butt in as outsiders.」

stage0012_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ミシェル$$
（That guy $$アルト$$...
　is he seeing himself leaving home, in them...）

stage0012_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$アルト$$
「But we've got our own reasons not to lose.
　You said you'd do it, so you'd better win.」

stage0012_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$アルト$$
「What is it, Miss $$スズネ$$?」

stage0012_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$スズネ$$
「No... it's nothing, $$アルト$$.
　Don't worry about it.」

stage0012_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$甲児$$
「Can't be helped...
　Guess we'll play coach, then.」

stage0012_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$かなめ$$
「But what can you do in so little time?」

stage0012_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$宗介$$
「Above all, they lack the will to fight.」

stage0012_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$アルト$$
「Alright! Once squats are done,
　next up is circuit training!」

stage0012_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$甲児$$
「Can't hear you!
　You won't beat Garasuyama like that!」

stage0012_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「I see...
　So the plan is to train hard at this camp.」

stage0012_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$クラン$$
「Not a bad plan, but why the mountains, of all places?」

stage0012_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$n
「Nature gives us the will to fight...
　Humanity's fought it throughout our evolution.」

stage0012_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Huh... that's a good line!
　You're a poet, $n!」

stage0012_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I thought so back on the hike too...
　$n's surprisingly the outdoorsy type.」

stage0012_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Was that your hobby, maybe,
　before you came to Jindai High?」

stage0012_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Like how Sousuke grew up on a battlefield...
　did you live in the mountains, or something?」

stage0012_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$スズネ$$
（There it is again...
　The moment someone asks about before
　he transferred, he shuts right up...）

stage0012_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Uh... um... by the way, where's Sousuke?」

stage0012_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「He said he'd swing by the Quarter for
　something first, then come.」

stage0012_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Hmm...
　Well, he couldn't coach worth anything anyway,
　so never mind...」

stage0012_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$かなめ$$
「But with just me, Miss $$スズネ$$, and $$さやか$$,
　being managers is going to be rough...」

stage0012_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$かなめ$$
「If $$ワッ太$$ and $$正太郎$$ could've helped too,
　that would've been nice...」

stage0012_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$さやか$$
「$$正太郎$$'s helping $$ＩＣＰＯ$$
　with some other investigation.」

stage0012_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ボス$$
「$$ワッ太$$ skips school too much,
　so he's slammed with makeup classes.」

stage0012_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Being the boss is rough, huh.
　Guess it's just us here, then.」

stage0012_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$スズネ$$
「But even with Alto and Kouji working hard,
　will the rugby club actually get stronger...」

stage0012_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$n
「I think they've gotten a little better,
　but without something decisive, it'll be tough.」

stage0012_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$n
「Something that changes them at the core...
　something on the scale of changing who they are.」

stage0012_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「I see...
　So the plan is to train hard at this camp.」

stage0012_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$クラン$$
「Not a bad plan, but why the mountains, of all places?」

stage0012_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$n
「Nature gives us the will to fight...
　Humanity's fought it throughout our evolution.」

stage0012_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Huh... that's a good line!
　You're a poet, $n!」

stage0012_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Was that your hobby, maybe,
　before you came to Jindai High?」

stage0012_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Like how Sousuke grew up on a battlefield...
　did you live in the mountains, or something?」

stage0012_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$スズネ$$
（There it is again...
　The moment someone asks about before
　he transferred, he shuts right up...）

stage0012_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Uh... um... by the way, where's Sousuke?」

stage0012_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「He said he'd swing by the Quarter for
　something first, then come.」

stage0012_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Hmm...
　Well, he couldn't coach worth anything anyway,
　so never mind...」

stage0012_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「But with just me, Miss $$スズネ$$, and $$さやか$$,
　being managers is going to be rough...」

stage0012_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$かなめ$$
「If $$ワッ太$$ and $$正太郎$$ could've helped too,
　that would've been nice...」

stage0012_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$さやか$$
「$$正太郎$$'s helping $$ＩＣＰＯ$$
　with some other investigation.」

stage0012_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$ボス$$
「$$ワッ太$$ skips school too much,
　so he's slammed with makeup classes.」

stage0012_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Being the boss is rough, huh.
　Guess it's just us here, then.」

stage0012_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$スズネ$$
「But even with Alto and Kouji working hard,
　will the rugby club actually get stronger...」

stage0012_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$n
「I think they've gotten a little better,
　but without something decisive, it'll be tough.」

stage0012_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$n
「Something that changes them at the core...
　something on the scale of changing who they are.」

stage0012_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$甲児$$
「No good, no good, no good!
　If you go down from something like this,
　you can't hope to beat Garasuyama!」

stage0012_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$アルト$$
「Don't decide your own limit!
　If you love rugby, get up!」

stage0012_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$宗介$$...!
　Where have you been all this time!?」

stage0012_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$宗介$$
「...Listen up, you lot.
　Hear me well.」

stage0012_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$宗介$$
「What a sight, all of you!
　You're the lowest maggots there are!」

stage0012_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$宗介$$
「Ticks!
　The lowest life forms in this universe!」

stage0012_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$宗介$$
「Listen, you worms!
　My pleasure is watching you all suffer!」

stage0012_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$宗介$$
「Wheezing like a bunch of old men
　out on a marathon!」

stage0012_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$かなめ$$
「H-he's trying to fire them up, I guess,
　but does he even get what he's saying...!?」

stage0012_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$宗介$$
「Now run, you slowpokes!
　There's no rest till my mood improves!」

stage0012_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$宗介$$
「Call me Sir!
　The only sound you're allowed is a war cry!」

stage0012_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$宗介$$
「You, $$石原$$!
　Your guts were always this pathetic, then!」

stage0012_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$宗介$$
「Can't run anymore!
　Then crawl home and sleep hugging a photo
　of your beloved Miki Matsuura!」

stage0012_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$宗介$$
「Though naturally, an idol adored by
　a coward like you
　must be a hopeless tramp indeed!」

stage0012_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$石原$$
「Don't you dare badmouth my Mikiki!」

stage0012_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$宗介$$
「I'll say it as many times as it takes!
　Miki Matsuura is a tramp!
　Show some guts if you disagree!」

stage0012_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$郷田$$! Who's your favorite idol!」

stage0012_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$宗介$$
「You run too!
　Or will you prove that $$ランカ・リー$$
　is a tramp instead!」

stage0012_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$アルト$$
「That bastard!
　Who does he think $$ランカ$$ is!」

stage0012_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$甲児$$
「C-calm down, $$アルト$$!
　That's just to fire up the team, that's all!」

stage0012_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$宗介$$
「Listen, you worms!
　To purge the rotten civilian softness in you,
　I've called in a special guest today!」

stage0012_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$竜馬$$
「So basically, I just gotta beat some
　guts into these guys, huh.」

stage0012_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Heh... that's an easy enough task.」

stage0012_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Here we go!
　No need to hold back, come at me all at once!」

stage0012_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Now then... how many will walk away alive?」

stage0012_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$甲児$$
「R-$$竜馬$$!
　And $$ヴィラル$$ too...!」

stage0012_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$宗介$$
「Hm... when I went back to the Quarter,
　those two happened to be there.
　I explained the situation, and they agreed at once.」

stage0012_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$さやか$$
「That man with the red scarf is $$流竜馬$$.
　He's the legendary Getter Robo's pilot,
　and $$甲児$$'s martial arts teacher too.」

stage0012_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$ボス$$
「Scary as hell, that guy.
　Though as an ally, he's the most reliable there is.」

stage0012_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$甲児$$
「That beastman over there is $$ヴィラル$$...
　he's a comrade who fought alongside us too.
　...But why's he in Japan?」

stage0012_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$宗介$$
「The two apparently reunited on a training journey,
　and since they happened to stop by $$第２新東京市$$,
　they came to greet the Quarter.」

stage0012_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$甲児$$
「But hey... what was that thing you did?」

stage0012_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That's right!
　What was that vulgar way of cheering us on!?」

stage0012_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$宗介$$
「I merely put this into practice.」

stage0012_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Let's see...
　Boss $$マオ$$'s Marine Insult Handbook: Recruit Edition...
　...No good, this...」

stage0012_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$石原$$
「N-no good...
　At this rate, I'm really going to die...」

stage0012_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$ボビー$$
「Oh my, look at you go.」

stage0012_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$石原$$
「S-someone with our exact vibe just showed up...!」

stage0012_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$ボビー$$
「Fufu... brings back memories.
　This sweat, this heat...」

stage0012_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$ボビー$$
「Seeing this oval ball
　takes me back to when they called me
　the Black Devil of Dalmatian High...」

stage0012_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ボビー$$
「Hey, you lot! Get up already!
　It's way too soon to kiss the ground!!」

stage0012_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Come to think of it, I heard something...
　that Captain $$ボビー$$ used to play American football...」

stage0012_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Position: quarterback...
　and the nickname born from how fearsome he was...
　the Black Devil of Dalmatian High...」

stage0012_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$宗介$$
「I see...
　So that's the background behind him
　volunteering as coach, different sport or not.」

stage0012_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Rise, all of you!
　To live is to fight!」

stage0012_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Face forward! Glare at your enemy!
　If you don't want to die, take them down!」

stage0012_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$ボビー$$
「Think of the guy in front as your parent's killer!
　Hit them like you mean to kill!」

stage0012_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
Firebug Trooper
「What the hell are these guys!?」

stage0012_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$宗介$$
「Listen! Right now, you're all subhuman!」

stage0012_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$宗介$$
「Nameless trash!
　Only once you survive my training
　will you finally become weapons!」

stage0012_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$宗介$$
「I hate you all, and I despise you!」

stage0012_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$宗介$$
「My job is to find the weaklings
　among you and cut them out!」

stage0012_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$宗介$$
「No laughing, no crying, allowed!
　You are not human!
　You are machines built for slaughter!」

stage0012_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$宗介$$
「If you can't kill, you have no reason to exist!」

stage0012_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$宗介$$
「Want to lose on purpose to stand out!
　Fake pain to win yourself some sympathy!
　You loser trash heap of dogs!」

stage0012_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$宗介$$
「Don't crawl along, you trash!
　That ball is the only girlfriend you have!!」

stage0012_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...Hey... sorry to spoil the mood, but
　that group getting beaten to a pulp over there...
　are they extras you hired?」

stage0012_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$正太郎$$
「It's terrible!
　A group of terrorists is apparently hiding
　in the mountains where you're all training!」

stage0012_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$正太郎$$
「We're heading your way too, but
　please evacuate right away!」

stage0012_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$正太郎$$
「What's going on!?
　I keep hearing screams, are you all right!?」

stage0012_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$アルト$$
「Ah... yeah...
　If you mean them, they're already taken care of...」

stage0012_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$かなめ$$
「H-hey, everyone, look!
　Something's coming from over there!」

stage0012_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$ファイヤバグ$$ Trooper
「Damn it...!
　To think $$ファイヤバグ$$'s fallen this far...!」

stage0012_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
Firebug Trooper
「Ever since the $$姫$$ fired us,
　nothing's gone right for us...」

stage0012_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
Firebug Trooper
「If we don't find a new $$姫$$ soon,
　we've got no future...!」

stage0012_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
Firebug Trooper
「There he is, the fumo-fumo freak!」

stage0012_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
Firebug Trooper
「If only you hadn't shown up, we'd have...!」

stage0012_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Don't look so pleased with yourself!」

stage0012_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
Sousuke
「What was that for, Chidori?
　It's me... $$相良宗介$$.」

stage0012_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I figured that out without being told!」

stage0012_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$宗介$$
「Why is that?
　Did you spot my motion pattern?」

stage0012_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$かなめ$$
「You're the only person crazy enough
　to pull a stunt like that!」

stage0012_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$甲児$$
「Still, that $$ボン太くん#robot$$ sure was something...」

stage0012_03:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$宗介$$
「Affirmative.
　I made it as new urban warfare gear.」

stage0012_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$宗介$$
「This is a cheap costume suit fitted with
　sensors, digital comms, ballistic
　protection, and power assist added.」

stage0012_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$宗介$$
「Done right, it might completely change
　the face of urban warfare.」

stage0012_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$アルト$$
「Sure, if the whole ground force went around
　saying 'fumofumo', it'd flip everything we know!」

stage0012_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$n
「What in the world is with that way of talking?」

stage0012_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$宗介$$
「...Even I don't fully understand it.
　The voice changer converts all
　of my speech into that voice.」

stage0012_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$宗介$$
「But if I switch that function off,
　the whole system crashes.
　There's still room for improvement.」

stage0012_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Since $n and the others are too stunned
　to speak, I'll say it myself!」

stage0012_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Before you improve anything, fix that
　mindset from the ground up!!」

stage0012_03:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「...Your new comrade is quite the odd one.」

stage0012_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$竜馬$$
「But he might just surprise us.
　You know the strength of a fool
　who ignores common sense, don't you?」

stage0012_03:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Then farewell, $$竜馬$$.
　I'll continue my training journey.」

stage0012_03:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Take care of yourself.
　I'm glad I got to meet you.」

stage0012_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Likewise for me.
　Next time we meet, let's both
　have grown even stronger.」

stage0012_03:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Same here.
　Let's drink through the night again then.」

stage0012_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Right.
　With $$シモン$$ and the others too.」

stage0012_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$かなめ$$
「What are you talking about!
　The whole point of this training camp
　was getting the rugby club to win, remember!?」

stage0012_03:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$宗介$$
「No need to worry.
　They crossed the line of death as perfect machines.」

stage0012_03:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$宗介$$
「As of this moment, you graduate from being maggots!
　You are rugby men now!」

stage0012_03:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$宗介$$
「Do you love your school!
　Do you love the rugby club!!」

stage0012_03:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Heh heh heh, $$兜甲児$$.
　The battle isn't over yet.」

stage0012_03:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「Without Mazinger, you're nothing to me!
　Now I and the Iron Cross Legion guide you to hell...」

stage0012_03:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$宗介$$
「Listen up!
　Now is the time to sortie!」

stage0012_03:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$ブロッケン$$
「S-stop!
　My head is not a ball!」

stage0012_03:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Amazing...!
　What incredible spirit!
　We can expect great things in the match!」

stage0012_03:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$アルト$$
「Ah, forget it... come what may!」

stage0012_03:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$かなめ$$
「As dusk crept over the mountain field,
　the screams of $$ブロッケン伯爵$$ and the
　Iron Cross Legion echoed on and on...」

stage0012_03:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Yes... on and on, forever and ever...」

stage0012_03:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$かなめ$$
「And so, they came down from the mountain,
　and set off for the final battleground.」

stage0012_03:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$恭子$$
「Morning, Kana.
　That rugby match yesterday was something.」

stage0012_03:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$恭子$$
「Who knew that quiet rugby club
　had it in them to fight so fiercely.」

stage0012_03:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$恭子$$
「I was too far away to see it well,
　but people close by went pale from
　the intensity, and the kids all cried.」

stage0012_03:r_d90c4affdd742a0e.text:
$$恭子$$
「But it's a shame, isn't it...
　how so many of the Garasuyama High
　players got hurt and the game got cut short.」

stage0012_03:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$恭子$$
「Oh, Kana... it's been 'yeah' this whole time!
　I've got day duty, so I'll go ahead.」

stage0012_03:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$宗介$$
「One for all...
　By each fulfilling the creed of one
　kill apiece, they wiped out the enemy unit.」

stage0012_03:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$宗介$$
「What are you doing, Chidori?
　We completed the mission, so we should be glad.」

stage0012_03:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Sure, thanks to Garasuyama forfeiting,
　our rugby club got the win, but still!」

stage0012_03:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$n
「I get how Chidori feels, but
　going along with what $$宗介$$ says
　is easier on the nerves here...」

stage0012_03:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That clears the challenge the president set!
　The Volunteer Club is officially approved now.」

stage0012_03:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$アルト$$
「But we've got problems piling up.
　With $$宗介$$ around, we'll keep having to
　clean up after stunts like yesterday's.」

stage0012_03:r_8a9ac301023aa8d3.text:
$$かなめ$$
「About that, $$アルト$$...
　I talked it over with Miss $$スズネ$$,
　and we want you to be the club president.」

stage0012_03:r_4cab8ba7b88b6c2a.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「I second that.
　After all, $$アルト$$'s even served as
　acting Skull Leader before.」

stage0012_03:r_38f89a2d27debb9e.text:
$$甲児$$
「True enough.
　And he's surprisingly considerate too.」

stage0012_03:r_20aab898d4d14e51.text:
$n
「He carries himself well commanding people too.」

stage0012_03:r_e418ba9e04898c28.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$かなめ$$'s the one to keep $$宗介$$ in line, right?」

stage0012_03:r_88461d9fd17c56e7.text:
$$かなめ$$
「What are you saying.
　If I became president, wouldn't it look odd
　for me to be at school when you all deploy?」

stage0012_03:r_d7bf635b7e5f811c.text:
$$かなめ$$
「So anyway, I'll be the manager.
　Well... that's as far as I'll run things,
　I'll leave the rest to the president.」

stage0012_03:r_9f17991d2b19374c.text:
$$甲児$$
「The birth of a new president, huh.」

stage0012_03:r_9bf1948e282e5587.text:
$$アルト$$
「This is the president to all hands.
　Starting today, we begin operating
　as the Volunteer Club!」

stage0012_03:r_67c9e002d64d9781.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Roger that.
　Counting on you, Mr. President.」

stage0012_03:r_cb5e5d90104f7a88.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Hey, you two!
　Dawdle around there and you'll be late!」

stage0012_03:r_34f8d5cbd504c416.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$竜馬$$!
　Why are you at Jindai High!?」

stage0012_03:r_8246cdac0973a25f.text:
$$宗介$$
「Don't tell me you're enrolling here too?」

stage0012_03:r_0a597f4cd9c8309b.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That's way too much of a stretch...」

stage0012_03:r_fc7afc4ebf9fd013.text:
$$大貫$$
「Ryu here is starting today
　as the janitor's assistant at Jindai High.」

stage0012_03:r_1608d4c4d3f78b24.text:
$$大貫$$
「I'm not getting any younger.
　Doing all the school's chores alone
　was getting to be too much.」

stage0012_03:r_149109e3b1cf253b.text:
$$竜馬$$
「My training journey finally ran me
　out of money. So I figured settling
　into steady work wouldn't be so bad.」

stage0012_03:r_1de04d77f1060720.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Naturally, I'll help out with
　this Volunteer Club of yours too.」

stage0012_03:r_ffee8be5e866ae97.text:
$$甲児$$
「Got it!
　Keep training with me from now on too!」

stage0012_03:r_bc2050dd9e12f5a4.text:
$$宗介$$
「Heh... looks like this school's about to get lively.」

stage0012_03:r_7d1683c9b3b3094a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Still, Miss $$ボビー$$... you really shone this time.」

stage0012_03:r_2249da179abb6501.text:
$$ボビー$$
「That's true.
　The $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ youngsters seemed surprised
　by a side of me they'd never seen.」

stage0012_03:r_3f3b91470236b2a8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My my... they really do say
　you can't judge a book by its cover.」

stage0012_03:r_490618028b4c53d6.text:
$$ボビー$$
「That's right, $$ＡＧ$$.
　Everyone keeps a beast inside their heart.」

stage0012_03:r_1a6f62daa82363ae.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As a robot I can't quite follow,
　but I suppose that's how humans are.」

stage0012_03:r_6b6dd25816c18fc5.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So, exactly how did the Black Devil
　of Dalmatian High turn into
　such a gaudy old queen?」

stage0012_03:r_60cd511150394b50.text:
$$ボビー$$
「Ah, whatever...
　This is the path I chose, after all.」

stage0012_03:r_33e42009af9a0b54.text:
$$ボビー$$
「It's a long story, but want to hear it?
　The story of my life so far...」

stage0012_03:r_7fc1d3642481712b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... no, I've got work to do!
　Well then, let's get to it... business, business!」
